positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of the JSCompiler, a JavaScript to JavaScript compiler performing static analysis, optimization and code compression.

In this position, I was responsible for the elaboration and implementation of a static type system for JavaScript (http://code.google.com/closure/compiler/docs/js-for-compiler.html). The type system created combines type inference and type checking in the goal of requiring type annotations solely on functions' signatures. I was also a member of the ECMA technical group TC39 working on the ECMAScript 4 language, envisioned to replace the current ECMAScript 3 (a.k.a. JavaScript 1.5) specification.

positions.description: The theoretical and practical aspects of building modem compilers. Topics: intermediate representations, basic blocks and flow-graphs, data flow analysis, register allocation, global code optimizations, and interprocedural analysis.

positions.description: Research Assistant to Professor John C. Mitchell, working on type inference in presence of positive subtyping.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Pascal Perez a seize ans quand il crée sa société spécialisée dans le IT, la gestion de contenu. "C'était le boum de la nouvelle économie, les journaux ne parlaient que de ça! Je voulais absolument y participer..." Pendant un an, il développe un système de gestion de contenu permettant de simplifier la construction de sites webs et remporte vite un vif succès.
